title: Detailed ice cream cone
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Cone -->
  <polygon points="38,55 62,55 50,92" fill="#E8A33D"/>
  <polygon points="38,55 62,55 50,92" fill="none" stroke="#F5C86E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Cone cross-hatch lines -->
  <line x1="40" y1="60" x2="60" y2="60" stroke="#D4882A" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="41" y1="66" x2="59" y2="66" stroke="#D4882A" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="43" y1="72" x2="57" y2="72" stroke="#D4882A" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="45" y1="78" x2="55" y2="78" stroke="#D4882A" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="43" y1="55" x2="49" y2="90" stroke="#D4882A" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="55" x2="50" y2="92" stroke="#D4882A" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="57" y1="55" x2="51" y2="90" stroke="#D4882A" stroke-width="1.2"/>

  <!-- Bottom scoop (strawberry) -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="52" r="17" fill="#F78FB3"/>
  <path d="M33,52 Q30,38 50,38 Q70,38 67,52" fill="#FA9FC4"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="46" r="3" fill="#FBB5D2"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="49" r="2.5" fill="#FBB5D2"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="55" r="2" fill="#FBB5D2"/>

  <!-- Middle scoop (mint) -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="35" r="15" fill="#8EE8C0"/>
  <path d="M35,35 Q33,22 50,22 Q67,22 65,35" fill="#A5F0D0"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="30" r="3" fill="#BFF7E0"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="33" r="2.5" fill="#BFF7E0"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="38" r="2" fill="#BFF7E0"/>

  <!-- Top scoop (chocolate) -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="19" r="13" fill="#C97B4A"/>
  <path d="M37,19 Q35,7 50,7 Q65,7 63,19" fill="#D68B5A"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="14" r="2.5" fill="#E0A070"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="16" r="2" fill="#E0A070"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="21" r="2" fill="#E0A070"/>

  <!-- Cherry -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="6" r="4" fill="#FF4757"/>
  <circle cx="48.5" cy="4.5" r="1.2" fill="#FF8080"/>
  <path d="M50,2 Q54,-2 57,0" fill="none" stroke="#6BCB77" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Sprinkles on top scoop -->
  <rect x="42" y="10" width="4" height="1.5" rx="0.75" fill="#FFD93D" transform="rotate(30 44 11)"/>
  <rect x="54" y="9" width="4" height="1.5" rx="0.75" fill="#6BCB77" transform="rotate(-20 56 10)"/>
  <rect x="47" y="18" width="4" height="1.5" rx="0.75" fill="#FF6B9D" transform="rotate(50 49 19)"/>
  <rect x="39" y="16" width="4" height="1.5" rx="0.75" fill="#4DA6FF" transform="rotate(-40 41 17)"/>
  <rect x="57" y="20" width="3.5" height="1.5" rx="0.75" fill="#FFD93D" transform="rotate(15 59 21)"/>

  <!-- Drip detail on bottom scoop -->
  <path d="M38,58 Q36,63 38,66 Q40,63 39,58" fill="#F78FB3"/>
  <path d="M61,56 Q63,61 61,64 Q59,61 60,56" fill="#F78FB3"/>

  <!-- Sprinkles on middle scoop -->
  <rect x="41" y="27" width="3.5" height="1.5" rx="0.75" fill="#FFD93D" transform="rotate(25 42 28)"/>
  <rect x="55" y="26" width="3.5" height="1.5" rx="0.75" fill="#FF6B9D" transform="rotate(-35 56 27)"/>
  <rect x="48" y="33" width="3.5" height="1.5" rx="0.75" fill="#FF8C42" transform="rotate(60 49 34)"/>

  <!-- Sprinkles on bottom scoop -->
  <rect x="40" y="48" width="3.5" height="1.5" rx="0.75" fill="#4DA6FF" transform="rotate(-30 41 49)"/>
  <rect x="58" y="45" width="3.5" height="1.5" rx="0.75" fill="#FFD93D" transform="rotate(45 59 46)"/>
  <rect x="46" y="54" width="3.5" height="1.5" rx="0.75" fill="#6BCB77" transform="rotate(20 47 55)"/>
  <rect x="53" y="51" width="3" height="1.5" rx="0.75" fill="#FF8C42" transform="rotate(-25 54 52)"/>
</svg>
